title: Evaluating Empathetic Chatbots in Customer Service Settings
reasoning: The paper evaluates chatbots on their ability to generate empathetic responses in a customer service context. While empathy can be considered a moral or ethical quality in humans, the paper treats it as a functional skill to be learned and measured for better task performance (mimicking human agents). It does not engage in a broader ethical analysis, moral benchmarking, or discussion of religious/faith-based perspectives.
